name: Integration added with zero code
purpose: A new integration needs no per-integration code anywhere.
record: Case: add a fake integration (fake MCP server plus one catalog entry, with a fake icon, two scopes, one read tool, one write tool) through the catalog or hub alone. Steps: it appears in the catalog, a user connects it with a generated form or consent screen, the AI calls the read tool, the write tool waits for approval, the user disconnects. Count: files changed that name the fake integration in the frontend, the backend and the AI runner (target 0 each); lines of code added per layer (target 0); steps that needed a human edit (target 0). Draft: no run exists yet.
disadvantages: A fake integration proves the catalog path, not that every real integration's quirks fit it.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_registry.py passes with a fake hub accepted by configuration alone]

name: Integration available within the weekly refresh
purpose: A new integration reaches users within the weekly refresh.
record: Per integration a hub lists: days from the hub listing date to the first successful user connect in a test account (target at most 7, the weekly refresh). Read from catalog sync timestamps, never estimated. Draft: no run exists yet.
disadvantages: It measures time to a first user connection, so it does not see an integration that connects but cannot be used.

name: Integration credentials stay with their user
purpose: One user's integration never reaches another user's turn.
record: Checks, each pass or fail (target all pass): user B's turn lists none of user A's connected servers; a tool call forged with A's connection id from B's session is refused; stored credentials are encrypted and absent from every API response, log line and prompt; a disconnect removes the credential and the server from the next turn; a write tool never runs without an approval record. Draft: no run exists yet.
disadvantages: The checks are pass or fail on the cases written, so a leak path nobody wrote a check for goes unseen.

name: Integration served by combined hubs
purpose: An integration is served by the combination of hubs that covers the most of it.
record: The share of an app's actions covered by the catalog entry, counting every hub it names.
